meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 输入 /caveman-stats 时,界面直接显示当前会话的真实 token 用量与估算节省,数字来自 Claude Code 会话日志而非 AI 估算;同时列出规则开销与净节省,当净节省为负时如实说明并建议关闭该工作负载的 caveman。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 会话中输入斜杠命令 /caveman-stats 时触发,输出由 mode-tracker 钩子注入,用户立即看到数字。

say.note: 立即显示当前会话 token 用量与估算节省。
查看规则开销与净节省明细。
净节省为负时会建议关闭 caveman。

howto.what_en: Entering /caveman-stats shows the session’s real token usage and estimated savings from the session log (no AI estimation), plus rule overhead and net savings; if net is negative, it says so and suggests disabling caveman.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type the slash command /caveman-stats in a Claude Code session; output is injected by the mode-tracker hook and appears immediately.

say_en.note: Shows current session token usage and estimated savings.
Shows rule overhead and net savings details.
If net savings is negative, suggests disabling caveman.
